payload.description:
When leftover is behind linear pace on a resetting window, dispatch interruptible Kanbus spot chores onto that pool. Per-product clocks. Preempt for on-demand.

Safest usage-management default: assume one agentic invocation may consume the rest of the window. One live spot run per pool. Re-probe after each chore. Optional wall-clock/turn caps are hints, not guarantees.

See docs/dispatch.md.

DoD: spare-pace scoring is specified and tested; hold/preempt reopens the Kanbus chore; no dispatch when leftover is unreadable or a hold is set.
payload.title: Dispatch leftover as spot tasks
